Login_File.name: standard
agent_activity_summary: Execution Summary
1. Agent navigated to https://unsplash.com/login and waited for the page to fully load, confirming login UI visibility (Step 1).
2. Agent captured a stable selector for the Email field and entered the provided username; multiple stabilization waits were used (Steps 2–7).
3. Agent attempted to capture the Password field selector and input the provided password; repeated captures ensured a stable selector (Steps 3–7).
4. Agent restarted the scenario to ensure a clean state and reloaded the login page (Step 8).

5. Agent re-captured stable selectors for Email and Password, re-entered the username and password with consistent identification of the Email field as page.getByRole('textbox', { name: 'Email' }) (Steps 9–12, 14–21, 23, 25).
6. Agent successfully captured a stable selector for the Password field and entered the password (Steps 13, 22).
7. Agent stabilized the page with additional waits before submission (Steps 24, 26).
8. Agent captured a stable selector for the Login button as page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Login' }), clicked it, and waited for navigation/response (Step 27).
9. Agent verified authenticated state by opening the profile menu on the homepage, confirming successful login (Step 28).
Issues & Recovery
- Step 13: Attempted to capture the Login button selector resulted in a mismatch; a selector for the Password textbox was generated instead of the button.
Recovery: Agent continued with additional stabilization and retries and later captured the correct Login button selector in Step 27.
- Step 22: Repeated attempt to capture the Login button again produced a selector associated with the Password textbox rather than the button.
Recovery: Agent proceeded with further retries and waits; correct Login button selector was captured and clicked in Step 27.
- Steps 2–7, 9–12, 14–21, 23, 25–26: Redundant re-capture and re-input loops occurred for Email/Password fields, indicating selector stabilization/interaction uncertainty.
Recovery: Agent performed a full page reload (Step 8) and additional waits (Steps 24, 26), then proceeded to successful submission (Step 27).
Outcome

Task completed successfully. Agent navigated to the login page, entered the provided credentials, submitted the form, and verified authenticated state via the profile menu. This matches the Original User Scenario.
Completed
True
Recommendation
- Use role-based selectors for the Login button from the outset (e.g., getByRole('button', { name: 'Login' })) to avoid selector mismatches.
- Consolidate input actions to avoid redundant re-captures; implement a single, explicit wait for ready state and field visibility before input.
- Add a post-click assertion for URL change or authenticated user indicators to confirm success deterministically.
- Improve error handling to detect and log selector mismatches immediately, reducing repeated loops.

User_Scenarios_File.name: unsplash_wallpaper_click.pdf
agent_activity_summary: Execution Summary
1. Navigated to https://unsplash.com/ and loaded the homepage.
2. Located the header search input. Attempted to verify the presence of the “Submit an image” button and the left-sidebar profile avatar.
3. Attempted to target the “Wallpapers” tab; initial selector capture mismatched to the search input (no click executed).
4. Located the “Wallpapers” tab via role-based selector and clicked it; navigated to https://unsplash.com/t/wallpapers.
5. Confirmed navigation to the Wallpapers URL; attempted to validate page elements (heading and submit button).
6. Attempted to verify the “Wallpapers” tab is selected and the “Submit to Wallpapers” button is visible; partial selector capture only.
7. Began targeting the first wallpaper card; initial selector capture drifted.
8. Captured a specific wallpaper card link and clicked it; waited for the photo detail page to load.
9. Reached the photo detail page; detected detail UI components.
10. Verified the Download button on the photo detail page to confirm the wallpaper opened.
Issues & Recovery

- Step 3: Selector mismatch when attempting to capture the “Wallpapers” tab; captured the search input instead (no click). Recovery: In Step 4, used a role-based selector to locate and click the correct “Wallpapers” link.
- Step 2: Incomplete logged-in validation; did not explicitly assert visibility of the “Submit an image” button or the left-sidebar profile avatar. Proceeded without remediation.
- Step 6: Incomplete category page validation; did not explicitly assert “Submit to Wallpapers” button visibility or the selected/highlighted state of the “Wallpapers” tab. Proceeded.
- Step 7: Selector drift when targeting the first wallpaper card. Recovery: In Step 8, captured a specific card link (“A glowing stag silhouette in…”) and clicked it successfully.
- Step 9: Brittle selector used for detail UI (“An X shapeChevron leftChevron”). Mitigated by asserting a robust “Download” button in Step 10.
Outcome

The primary goal was achieved: a wallpaper was opened from the Wallpapers tab and its detail page loaded successfully (Download button visible). However, several scenario validations were only partially or not explicitly asserted: logged-in indicators (“Submit an image” button and profile avatar), Wallpapers page heading visibility, “Submit to Wallpapers” button visibility, tab selected/highlighted state, and image grid visibility. The URL validation was implicitly satisfied by navigation to /t/wallpapers.
Completed
True
Recommendation
- Strengthen logged-in state checks: explicitly assert visibility of the “Submit an image” button and the left-sidebar profile avatar using stable, semantic selectors.

- Validate category page UI: assert the Wallpapers page heading text, visibility of the “Submit to Wallpapers” button, selected/highlighted state of the “Wallpapers” tab (e.g., aria-current/selected), and presence of the image grid (count > 0).

- Improve selector targeting: scope queries to the category navigation bar for the “Wallpapers” tab; select the first wallpaper card from the masonry grid using deterministic locators (e.g., data-test IDs) and await visibility before clicking.
- Add explicit waits and assertions: wait for heading/button visibility or network idle after navigation; explicitly assert URL contains “/t/wallpapers”.
- Prefer robust role-based/text selectors: e.g., getByRole('heading', { name: 'Wallpapers' }), getByRole('button', { name: 'Submit to Wallpapers' }), and verify tab selection via ARIA attributes.
